body:
Requesting changes.

Scope: the worker diff (1191372..HEAD) is 10 files (+1089/-2) - new test/job scaffolding only, with zero changed lines under src/, ao-client/, or the 15 pre-existing test files. Note the branch predates main's verdict law, EN-010 fix, and gates rewrite (base 1191372); a main..HEAD two-dot diff misleadingly shows those as deletions. merge-tree reports zero conflicts, but rebase before merge and re-stamp the freeze under main's gate logic: this branch's shape_freeze.sh reads an external SPEC at ../packages/... that is absent here, so the sha16 re-stamp (dda9...) is unverifiable in-tree.

Verified with bun 1.4.2: DT-1b/DT-2/DT-3 pass in all 3 copies; the SPEC done-when passes in the job dir (3 pass, 1 file); the pre-existing suite is 42 pass / 2 fail where both failures (live_e2e cursor>0 on an idle daemon rail; ship_manifest fence2 adjudicate exit 1) reproduce on files this PR does not touch - pre-existing/environmental, not caused here. The live DT-1 full-loop was deliberately NOT executed (it spawns real agent sessions that push branches and open PRs).

Required findings are inline: (1) delete the byte-identical jobs/fence_bridge.test.ts - root bun test runs the live DT-1 twice; (2) un-hardcode DT-1's prId (:1) and assert g.ok; (3) DT-3 proves no loss and no restart - strengthen or retitle; (4) gate live DT-1 behind an opt-in/skip so the default suite stays hermetic; (5) remove the stray .aider files.

Inline as Consider: SPEC absolute paths; unconsumed transcript snapshots plus a gitignore rule that matches nothing (and a dropped trailing newline).

Body-only nits: REPO_ROOT unused (all 3 copies, line 28); readFileSync imported but unused (line 11); the SYNC_UPSET tag misnames a COUNT(*) (src/sync.ts returns the table count, not upserted rows); ATTRITE_OK typo; stale comment at lines 141-142 ("inject a synthetic one" - the code throws instead) plus unreachable scratch-synthetic branches (lines 180, 197) left behind by the ENFORCE commit; DT-1b lacks db.close().

What is good: DT-1b is a genuine mutation killer (UNCONFIRMED-PLAN path verified: merges=0, state unchanged); DT-2 is properly hermetic with real assertions and finally-cleanup; transcript/evidence discipline is solid; the job-dir subset copy correctly excludes the live test from the sandboxed fence; the SPEC sha16 pin verifies (fe5589... == sha256[:16] of the artifact).

comments.body: Required: this file is byte-identical to tests/dt_shapes.test.ts (verified: diff reports IDENTICAL, 383 lines). Root `bun test` discovers 18 files and runs every dt_shapes test 3x (measured: `bun test -t DT-1b` -> 3 pass across 18 files) - including the LIVE DT-1 full-loop twice: two real AO session spawns, two workers pushing branches and opening PRs, up to ~2x7 min of polling. The SPEC pins only jobs/upper-tier-dt-shapes/fence_bridge.test.ts (sha16 fe5589... matches that file), so this copy is unreferenced. Delete it, or scope test discovery so it cannot double-execute.

Required: hardcoded `pr:${sessionId}:1`, but upsertPr keys rows `pr:<session>:<pr_number>` from AO (src/sync.ts:23). If the minted PR is not #1, guardrail(db, prId) returns PR-MISSING while the test still merges and passes - the GUARD transcript line contradicts the outcome. And `g.ok` is recorded (line 162) but never asserted, so a genuinely ineligible gate goes unnoticed. Derive prId from the synced rows (SELECT id ... WHERE session_id = ?) and assert gate eligibility before planning. (Same code in jobs/fence_bridge.test.ts.)

Required: this test is titled a kill-9 storm / loss-replay but injects no loss and performs no restart: all 20 cycles share one live :memory: connection (a real kill -9 destroys it) and feed perfectly ordered, disjoint batches - so dupes=0/gaps=0 is asserted over inputs containing neither. Use a file-backed DB with close/reopen per cycle (a real restart) plus at least one overlapping batch and one skipped-seq batch asserting gap counting and resync - or retitle so the fence does not certify an unproven claim. The final idempotent re-feed is good; keep it. (Same code in both other copies.)

Required: DT-1 fails the whole default suite without a daemon (stated ENFORCE-BY-DEFAULT design), and green runs spawn real agent sessions that push branches and open PRs. The fence itself cannot run it (no network in the sandbox - hence the subset copy). Gate the live test behind an explicit opt-in (e.g. DT1_LIVE=1, else test.skip - a skip is honest, not a BLOCKED-pass) or move it out of default `bun test` discovery into a job-only target. (Same code in jobs/fence_bridge.test.ts.)

Required: stray reviewer-session droppings - a failed aider invocation referencing another session's reviewer prompt paths - swept into fe79f99. Remove this file and .aider.input.history, and add .aider* to .gitignore so it cannot recur.

Consider: absolute machine paths (/home/leviathan/.ao/data/worktrees/...) break on any other checkout or machine. Use repo-relative paths or env. (The sha16 pin itself checks out: fe5589... == sha256[:16] of the artifact.)

Consider: these committed run snapshots are unconsumed - nothing reads jobs/runtime/dt_transcripts (TXN_DIR defaults to $TMPDIR and nothing sets JFM_TXN_DIR) - and this file embeds a throwaway per-run git sha that can never match a future run. Consume them as goldens, move them out of the repo, or document them as sample output.

Consider: root-anchored `runtime/dt_transcripts/` does not cover `jobs/runtime/dt_transcripts/` (verified via git check-ignore: the committed JSONs are NOT ignored), and TXN_DIR never writes under repo runtime/ anyway - this rule matches nothing real. Fix the pattern or drop it. (This edit also dropped the file's trailing newline.)
